episodes.synopsis: Kamiya Agari is the ace of the Suzumegahara Table Tennis Team, but the arrival of Tsumujikaze Koyori reinvigorates the team and puts her place under threat.
episodes.title: My Heart's About to Burst!

episodes.synopsis: Agari feels more and more threatened by Koyori's rapid rise up the rankings, and she comes to a decision...
episodes.title: Unrelinquishable Spot

episodes.synopsis: Agari and Koyori face off in an all-out battle for the top spot.
episodes.title: Love It!!

episodes.synopsis: The table tennis team is shaken up by news that its captain is returning to the fold.
episodes.title: Boring Ping Pong

episodes.synopsis: Only Agari and Koyori stand between Kiruka and her perfect victory.
episodes.title: I Want to Feel My Heart Race with You

episodes.synopsis: Koyori needs new rubbers for her racket but can't pay for them, so she decides to work at Hokuto's specialized goods store.
episodes.title: Friends

episodes.synopsis: In a practice match against Mozuyama, a team that made a Nationals appearance, the Suzumegahara girls learn just what took them there.
episodes.title: The Ability of the National Schools

episodes.synopsis: Can Munemune and Kiruka claw one back in doubles and keep the match going?
episodes.title: Doubles

episodes.synopsis: Agari faces Mozuyama's captain, Zakuro, in a bid to make both Koyori's and her heart race.
episodes.title: Never Reach Me

episodes.synopsis: Koyori takes on Kururi in the final round of the practice match. Will she able to counter her opponent's curve drive and make her heart race?
episodes.title: My Brand of Table Tennis

episodes.synopsis: The Suzumegahara Table Tennis Team heads off on a training camp to prepare for the upcoming summer tournament.
episodes.title: Training Camp

episodes.synopsis: The team's training camp comes to an end, as each member of the team works on the issues they've identified. Will Agari be able to overcome hers?
episodes.title: Together, We Can Go as Far as We Want
